title: Simultaneous affine trivialization of finitely many finite free sheaf retracts
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open of X, s a finite set of integers, and M_n sheaves of O_U-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For each n in s assume maps i_n: M_n -> O_U^{m_n} and p_n: O_U^{m_n} -> M_n with i_n followed by p_n equal to the identity. If x is a point of U, there is an affine open V containing x inside U such that for every n in s the restriction of M_n along V <= U is isomorphic to O_V^{r_n} for some natural number r_n. There is no complex, differential, bound, or derived-category hypothesis or conclusion.

source.place: Tag 00NX (3) implies (7); schemes.tex Tags 01IA and 01IB; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00NX and /tag/01IA

proof.text: Induct on the finite set. For the empty set choose an affine neighbourhood inside U and discharge the vacuous conclusion.

For an inserted index apply the single-retract local trivialization theorem; apply the induction hypothesis to the remaining indices. Refine the intersection of the two neighbourhoods to an affine open containing x. Restrict both free isomorphisms to this open, using coproduct preservation and the unit comparison. Nested restriction is definitionally the direct restriction.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_trivialization_of_finite_retracts
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (s : Finset ℤ)
    (M : ℤ → SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
    (hM : ∀ n ∈ s, ∃ m : ℕ,
      ∃ (ι : M n ⟶ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
        (π : SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶ M n),
        ι ≫ π = 𝟙 (M n))
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ ∃ hVU : V ≤ U, IsAffine V.toScheme ∧
      ∀ n ∈ s, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty
        ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hVU)).obj (M n) ≅
          SheafOfModules.free
            (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))
